page.overview:
What is Blaster recirculator?

A blaster recirculator, was a high capacity component that used to transfer gas in blasters. It could be used to modify the rate of fire and power of a VM-19 heavy blaster pistol.

Blaster recirculators first appeared as weapon upgrade components in the 2024 Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws that was published by Ubisoft.
